no_hallucination_rule: Every value in this file was read on 2026-11-11 from the linked page and is stored next to the words the page printed. A value that could not be read is null and carries a flag. Nothing is inferred, estimated or filled in from memory, and no value is taken from a search-engine summary.
reader: Browser-rendered page reader. The sandbox has no general outbound internet from the shell, so a script cannot re-fetch these pages; the stored quotations are the evidence.
timestamp_rule: read_utc is the sandbox clock reading taken immediately before the batch of page reads that contained the page.
quote_rule: Quotations are the reader's text with line breaks collapsed. Where the reader ran two adjacent page elements together without a space (for example 'complaintsin' or 'Average of26'), the single missing space is restored. An ellipsis (…) marks omitted text between two parts of the same page. No word or digit is added, changed or reordered.

anchors.topic: Why look up complaints at all
anchors.quote: Find out what others say about a seller. Type its name and the words “complaint” or “review” into a search engine.

anchors.topic: Karat mark plus the maker's name or trademark
anchors.quote: Near the karat quality mark, look for the name or the U.S. registered trademark of the company that will stand behind the mark. The trademark may be a name, a symbol, or initials. If you’re thinking about buying a piece of gold jewelry but don’t see a trademark along with the karat mark, don’t buy it.
The phrase “solid gold” means the gold item isn’t hollow. The item will also have a karat mark like 14K or 18K to tell you how much gold is in the item.
If you have a problem with a jewelry purchase, try to resolve it with the seller first. If you’re not satisfied, report it to: the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov your state attorney general
The Jewelers Vigilance Committee (JVC) operates a mediation program that helps people who have disputes with jewelers.

anchors.topic: How BBB says its own profiles should be read
anchors.quote: BBB Business Profiles are provided solely to assist you in exercising your own best judgment. BBB does not verify the accuracy of information provided by third parties, and does not guarantee the accuracy of any information in Business Profiles. As a matter of policy, BBB does not endorse any product, service, or business.

When considering complaint information, please consider the company's size and volume of transactions. Note that the nature of complaints and a company’s responses to them are often more important than the number of complaints. BBB Business Profiles generally cover a three-year reporting period.

irregularities.title: Catbird: BBB grade D-, and none of the complaints shown was answered
irregularities.detail: BBB prints a D- rating, 11 complaints in three years (4 in the last twelve months) and files all 11 under 'Complaint Unanswered'. BBB defines Unanswered as 'The business failed to respond to the dispute.' Catbird's own contact page prints no customer-service telephone number.
irregularities.action: Before buying, test the seller's e-mail channel with the hallmark and return questions and keep the reply. Do not count on BBB as an escalation route for this seller.

irregularities.title: VRAI: BBB grade F, all three complaints unanswered, and a chargeback clause in the terms
irregularities.detail: The BBB profile named 'Vrai' (alternate name 'Vrai & Oro') prints an F rating and files all 3 complaints under 'Complaint Unanswered'. The profile prints no website or telephone, so its match to vrai.com rests on the name and on complaint texts that describe VRAI rings. Separately, VRAI's terms say that when a customer files a chargeback VRAI 'has the right to recover its direct and indirect costs'.
irregularities.action: Read the chargeback clause before paying by card, and ask VRAI in writing how it applies when a ring fails an independent purity test.

irregularities.title: Mejuri: BBB grade D-, 35 complaints, and no voice telephone or e-mail address printed
irregularities.detail: BBB prints a D- rating and 35 complaints in three years, 22 of them filed as 'Product Issues'; the customer-review average is 1/5 over 6 reviews. Mejuri's contact page prints a text-only number and a contact form; the only e-mail addresses printed are for press and corporate sales.
irregularities.action: Use the form or the text line to get the hallmark, hollow-form and return answers in writing before ordering.

irregularities.title: Mejuri calls hollow-form pieces “solid gold”
irregularities.detail: Mejuri's Materials FAQ says 'Even our hollow-form pieces are crafted entirely from solid gold'. The FTC consumer page read today says 'The phrase “solid gold” means the gold item isn’t hollow.' The dataset counts Mejuri's seven rows as carrying explicit solid-gold wording; that wording therefore does not by itself say a given Mejuri ring is not hollow.
irregularities.action: Ask Mejuri in writing whether the specific ring is hollow-form, and ask for its gram weight (no Mejuri row has one).

irregularities.title: Blue Nile and Allurez discount the price for paying by bank wire
irregularities.detail: Blue Nile: 'Arrange payment through your bank and receive a 1.5% discount.' Allurez: 'We offer a 1.5% discount to customers who pay with a wire transfer.' A wire cannot be disputed the way a card charge can, so the discount is an incentive to give up the protection the buying checklist asks for. Blue Nile's page also prints two different wire minimums ($1000 in the text, $750 in a tooltip).
irregularities.action: Pay by credit card and treat the wire discount as the price of losing dispute rights.

irregularities.title: Menē offers cryptocurrency and bank-wire payment, and has an unanswered BBB complaint about weight and marking
irregularities.detail: Menē's help centre lists 'BitPay cryptocurrency', 'Solana Pay' and 'Bank Deposit' (a wire) next to credit cards. BBB holds two profiles at the same address: 'Mene' (not rated, no complaints in three years, two 1-star reviews) and 'Mene Inc' (rated C, 1 complaint, unanswered). Menē's own help centre says small components and solder are 18-karat and that a metal tester touching them 'will be less than 24k gold purity', and that physical weight 'may differ slightly' from the advertised weight.
irregularities.action: Pay by card only. On arrival weigh the piece against the certificate, and have a jeweler test away from any solder seam.

irregularities.title: Sarraf: the seller itself confirms a shipped weight below the listed approximate weight
irregularities.detail: In a reply printed on BBB (09/24/2025) Sarraf writes: 'The chain was listed on our website with an approximate weight of 6.13 grams, not 6.61 grams. The chain that was shipped weighed 5.7 grams.' That is one item, a chain rather than a ring, but it shows how far Sarraf's 'approximate' weights can sit from the delivered piece; six dataset rows use Sarraf gram weights in their gold-value arithmetic.
irregularities.action: Weigh on arrival and compare with the listing; redo the gold-value calculation with the measured weight.

irregularities.title: Sarraf's own dates and BBB's do not match
irregularities.detail: Sarraf's home page says 'In business since 1986' and its page title says 'Over 30 Years'; BBB prints 'Business Started: 11/20/1997' and 'Business Incorporated: 11/20/1997'. The two can both be true if the business predates its incorporation; neither page says so. Sarraf's claim of an A+ BBB rating is confirmed by the BBB page read today.
irregularities.action: No action needed beyond knowing which entity BBB's record covers.

irregularities.title: Blue Nile has two BBB profiles, and the newer one describes a different brand
irregularities.detail: The Seattle profile 'Blue Nile Inc' carries the complaint history (124 in three years). A second profile, 'Blue Nile' in King of Prussia, was opened on 7/22/2026, lists the alternate name 'Signet Jewelers', links to www.signetjewelers.com, and its description reads 'Rocksbox is a jewelry membership service…'. Signet's fiscal-2024 annual report lists Blue Nile among Signet's brands.
irregularities.action: Use the Seattle profile to read or file complaints.

irregularities.title: BBB prints two different three-year complaint totals for Brilliant Earth on one page
irregularities.detail: The summary line says '281 complaints in the last 3 years'; the filter on the same page says 'All complaint statuses (282)', and Answered (181) plus Resolved (101) add to 282.
irregularities.action: None; both figures are recorded as printed.

irregularities.title: Anjolee: an A+ BBB claim this pass could not confirm, and no card payment for buyers outside the US and Canada
irregularities.detail: Anjolee's FAQ says 'Anjolee has an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau'. The BBB profile read today says 'This business is NOT BBB Accredited' and the page text returned printed no rating letter, so the claim is neither confirmed nor contradicted here. Anjolee's customer-service page says it 'does not accept foreign credit cards (issued outside of the United States and Canada)' and takes only PayPal for international orders. BBB lists 'Wire Transfer' among Anjolee's payment methods; Anjolee's own page does not.
irregularities.action: Open the BBB profile in a browser to read the letter grade. A buyer with a card issued outside the US or Canada cannot use card payment here.

irregularities.title: No seller publishes, on the pages read, that every gold ring carries both a karat stamp and a maker's mark
irregularities.detail: Maker's mark: only Brilliant Earth names one (its lotus symbol). Karat stamp: Mejuri says every piece is stamped; Ross-Simons says so for its Italian gold assortment; Blue Nile and Catbird make general statements about real gold rings; Brilliant Earth shows a stamped ring in an image caption. Allurez, VRAI, Anjolee, Sarraf and Menē print no stamp statement on the pages read. A statement on a web page is a seller's claim and not evidence of a stamp inside any particular ring.
irregularities.action: Ask each seller in writing which marks are struck inside the specific ring, and check them with a loupe on arrival.

irregularities.title: Contact gaps on the sellers' own contact pages
irregularities.detail: No voice telephone number: Mejuri (text only) and Catbird. No customer e-mail address, a form only: Mejuri and Brilliant Earth, and Sarraf on its contact page (the dataset holds a Sarraf address from an earlier product-page read). Eight of the ten contact pages print no corporate street address.
irregularities.action: Keep a written record of every exchange; a form submission leaves you no copy unless you save one.

irregularities.title: Sarraf pages still display a July closure banner in November
irregularities.detail: The contact page and the product page both carry an image whose alternative text reads 'Sarraf Closed for 4th of July 2026', read on 11 November 2026.
irregularities.action: None; noted as a sign that site notices are not kept current.

limits: A BBB grade is BBB's opinion and covers about three years; it is not a finding about any ring, and BBB says it does not verify what third parties tell it.
Complaint counts are not adjusted for company size. A large retailer will have more complaints than a small one selling the same quality.
Only the first part of the longer BBB complaint and review lists was read: the summary counts and the most recent entries. Older entries were not read.
Seller pages were read through a browser-rendered reader at the times shown. A page can change the next day.
Where a page would not render or a statement was not found, the cell is blank and flagged. Nothing was filled in from memory, from a search summary or by inference.
No Trustpilot, Reddit, state attorney-general or court record was used as a source of values. No US state business registry was opened.
Nothing here establishes that any ring is solid gold, correctly stamped or worth its price. That still takes a scale, a loupe and a jeweler's test on arrival.
